caption:
Free tip: check your credit reports weekly. ✅

The three bureaus (Equifax, Experian, TransUnion) offer free reports through the official site, AnnualCreditReport.com. Look for accounts you don't recognize and wrong balances.

Spotting a mistake early makes it easier to dispute.

When did you last look at yours?
first_comment: Last time you read your full report: this month, this year, never? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Be honest: when did you last check? @creditscoretruths

card.headline: Read your full report for errors, not just the score.
